recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Traditional Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C)
Roll out pizza dough on floured surface
Spread tomato sauce evenly
Add torn mozzarella pieces
Drizzle with olive oil
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden
Top with fresh basil before serving

recipes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
recipes.description: Classic Thai stir-fried noodles with chicken and peanuts
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes
Heat oil in wok over high heat
Cook chicken until done, set aside
Scramble eggs in wok, set aside
Stir-fry garlic until fragrant
Add drained noodles and sauce mixture
Toss everything together with chicken and eggs
Garnish with peanuts, bean sprouts, and lime

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Flavorful ground beef tacos with fresh toppings
instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet over medium-high heat
Drain excess fat
Add taco seasoning and water according to package
Simmer for 5 minutes
Warm taco shells in oven
Fill shells with beef
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and desired toppings

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with feta cheese and olives
instructions: Combine lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and onion in large bowl
Add olives and feta cheese
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over salad
Toss gently to combine
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Veggie Stir Fry
recipes.description: Colorful mixed vegetables in savory sauce
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in large wok or skillet
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds
Add harder vegetables first (broccoli, carrots)
Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes
Add remaining vegetables
Add soy sauce and sesame oil
Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes
Garnish with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Classic Burger
recipes.description: Juicy beef burger with all the fixings
instructions: Divide beef into 4 equal portions and form patties
Season both sides with salt and pepper
Heat grill or skillet to medium-high
Cook patties 4-5 minutes per side for medium
Add cheese during last minute
Toast buns on grill
Assemble burgers with desired toppings

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Creamy Roman pasta with eggs, cheese, and pancetta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente
Meanwhile, cook pancetta until crispy
Beat eggs with Parmesan and pepper in bowl
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain pasta
Add hot pasta to pancetta pan
Remove from heat and quickly mix in egg mixture
Add pasta water to reach desired consistency
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Creamy tomato-based curry with tender chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spice blend for 30 minutes
Heat butter in large pot, sauté onion until soft
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Add marinated chicken, cook until browned
Add tomato sauce, simmer for 15 minutes
Stir in heavy cream
Simmer for 10 more minutes
Garnish with cilantro, serve over rice

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Classic Caesar with homemade dressing and croutons
instructions: Chop romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces
For dressing: blend garlic, anchovies, egg yolk, mustard, and lemon juice
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while blending
Season with salt and pepper
Toss lettuce with dressing
Top with Parmesan and croutons

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable curry in coconut milk sauce
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until soft
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder
Add potatoes and carrots, cook for 5 minutes
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes, and coconut milk
Bring to boil, then simmer for 20 minutes
Season with salt
Garnish with cilantro
Serve with rice or naan

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Crispy fish tacos with cabbage slaw and lime crema
instructions: Mix flour with paprika and season fish
Pan-fry fish until crispy and cooked through
Mix sour cream with lime juice for crema
Toss cabbage with lime juice
Warm tortillas
Assemble tacos with fish, slaw, avocado
Drizzle with lime crema
Top with cilantro and hot sauce

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Simple Italian salad with tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into 1/4 inch rounds
Arrange alternating slices on platter
Tuck basil leaves between slices
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic
Season with salt and pepper
Let sit for 10 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Beef Stir Fry
recipes.description: Tender beef with vegetables in savory sauce
instructions: Marinate beef in soy sauce and cornstarch for 15 minutes
Heat oil in wok over high heat
Stir-fry beef until browned, remove from wok
Add more oil, stir-fry vegetables until crisp-tender
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds
Return beef to wok
Add oyster sauce, toss to combine
Serve over rice

recipes.name: Hummus Bowl
recipes.description: Protein-packed bowl with homemade hummus and fresh vegetables
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil until smooth
Add water if needed for desired consistency
Season with salt
Spread hummus in bowl
Top with fresh vegetables
Drizzle with olive oil
Serve with pita bread

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: Sizzling chicken and peppers with warm tortillas
instructions: Season chicken with fajita seasoning
Heat oil in large skillet over high heat
Cook chicken until done, set aside
Sauté peppers and onions until tender
Return chicken to skillet, heat through
Warm tortillas
Serve chicken and peppers in tortillas
Top with desired toppings

recipes.name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Nutritious bowl with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and tahini dressing
instructions: Cook quinoa in water according to package directions
Roast sweet potato and chickpeas at 400°F for 25 minutes
Massage kale with a bit of olive oil
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup, and water
Assemble bowls with quinoa base
Top with roasted vegetables, kale, and avocado
Drizzle with tahini dressing

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.description: Garlic butter shrimp with white wine and lemon
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions
Heat olive oil and butter in large skillet
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook for 1 minute
Add shrimp, cook until pink (2-3 minutes per side)
Add white wine and lemon juice
Simmer for 2 minutes
Toss with cooked pasta
Garnish with parsley and Parmesan
